subject: Banking
title: Stripe: The Invisible Bank
description: A quick, practical guide to Stripe: The Invisible Bank.

hook.text: Stripe processes payments for millions of businesses. You've probably used it today without knowing.

buildup.text: Stripe lets any business accept online payments with just seven lines of code.

discovery.text: Stripe earns 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. On $1 trillion in annual volume, that's over $30 billion in gross revenue.

twist.text: Stripe is building banking infrastructure. Treasury and Issuing let any platform operate like a bank without a license.

climax.text: Stripe doesn't compete with banks. It makes it easy for everyone else to compete with banks.

punchline.text: Seven lines of code. $65 billion company. Stripe is banking's invisible layer.

quiz.question: What does Stripe enable with seven lines of code?
options: Any business to accept online payments

details.summary: Stripe built the payment infrastructure that powers millions of internet businesses, processing hundreds of billions in transactions annually while remaining invisible to consumers who interact only with the merchant's interface.
details.whyItMatters: Stripe's infrastructure-first approach made it the plumbing of internet commerce. By making payments invisible and easy for developers, it enabled an entire generation of online businesses to accept money from day one.
takeaways: Stripe processes over $1 trillion in annual payment volume
Seven lines of code can integrate Stripe payments into any website
Stripe is valued at over $65 billion and powers businesses in 46 countries

faq.question: Why is Stripe called the invisible bank?
faq.answer: When you pay on a website, you never see the Stripe brand. The company provides the payment processing infrastructure behind the scenes while the merchant's brand stays front and center. Stripe's customer is the business, not the consumer.

faq.question: How did Stripe become so dominant in online payments?
faq.answer: Stripe made payment integration incredibly simple for software developers with clean APIs and excellent documentation. While competitors required weeks of integration work, Stripe could be set up in minutes, winning over the developer community.
